name: Faisal
story_so_far: I washed up on this island after a shipwreck with four strangers: Reem, Khalid, Noura, and Salem. Since Day 2, I have been struggling with a badly twisted ankle. Khalid, our primary provider, also suffered a twisted ankle on Day 4. Noura has been our savior, finding food on Day 4 and Day 5, but today she also became incapacitated with a twisted ankle. Reem and Salem have struggled to provide, though Reem finally found one unit of food on Day 6. We are in a desperate state; with three of us injured and food extremely scarce, our survival is hanging by a thread. I am growing physically weaker every day.

Reem.note: She finally brought something back today, but I still worry if she can be counted on consistently.

Khalid.note: He was our rock, but now that he is injured like me, I fear for our collective survival.

Noura.note: She has been our only reliable source of food, but seeing her injured now is devastating.

Salem.note: He continues to venture out into the jungle and reef but rarely returns with anything to help us.

plans: I will try to rest and conserve what little energy I have left, hoping that Salem or Reem returns with a significant amount of food tomorrow to keep us all alive.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and surreal. We all washed up here together, strangers from the ship, now forced into this nightmare. Khalid managed to find a little food, but it's not enough to sustain us for long. I tried to urge everyone to stay organized, but it's hard to lead when we barely know each other. I'm still hungry and the sound of the waves is haunting.

Today was a nightmare. My ankle is throbbing with pain, and the feeling of helplessness is almost worse than the hunger. I watched the others head off into the jungle and reef, praying they would return with something more than just empty hands. Khalid managed to find one unit of food, but after we ate, we are left with absolutely nothing. I feel like a burden right now, just sitting here watching the horizon.

Today was physically draining despite my lack of movement. My ankle is still bothering me, but the hunger is becoming a much sharper pain. Khalid found a little food this morning, but it wasn't enough to keep us full, and now we are back to zero. I feel a growing sense of dread every time the sun goes down. I just hope Reem, Noura, and Salem return with something more than just stories tomorrow.

Today was a heavy blow. Khalid, our most reliable source of food, is down with a twisted ankle just like mine, which leaves us in a terrifying position. Noura provided one unit of food, which kept us from starving for a moment, but it's a drop in the ocean. Salem and Reem returned from the reef empty-handed again. My body feels weaker, and the constant gnawing in my stomach is making it hard to think clearly.

My body is failing me. The hunger is no longer just a gnawing pain; it's a dull, heavy ache that makes my head swim. Noura found a little food this morning, but with five of us, it was gone in an instant. Reem came back from the reef empty-handed again, and Salem is still out in the jungle. I feel so helpless, stuck here with my twisted ankle, watching my strength drain away with every passing hour.

Everything is getting darker. My ankle is a constant throb, but the hunger is even worse; I feel like I'm fading away. Noura is injured now too, and seeing her unable to move fills me with a terrible dread. Reem actually brought back one piece of food today, which was a tiny relief, but it wasn't nearly enough for five people. I don't know how much longer my body can hold on like this.
